opinions.notes: PASS means locally judged coherent enough for literary research reading, not an independent-human pass or authenticity/admission finding. Read all prose of chapters 85-87, lines 1-264 (129 prose paragraphs), including the ending. The deterioration accumulates through meals, sleep, changing visit etiquette and paper rather than one bad message; "从宫中丧讯传到如今，已过了几个月。" (86, line 101) and the further months in 87 avoid a same-night death/wedding collapse. Daiyu keeps teasing, preferences and ordinary tomorrow-plans; "没什么。早上都是说明日的事。" (86, line 165) is an effective retrospective death-voice, not a final testament. The thin-cup plan, cool medicine and paper preservation carry loss materially. Reservations: the nursing ledger and repeated corrections of soup, fabric, pillows and staffing sometimes prolong one lesson instead of changing the emotional relation. Backup medical help is sought quite late in the final day, and Baoyu, found nearby with only two title slips left, arrives after several post-death tasks; the text permits this but would benefit from more felt elapsed travel time. Marriage is knowingly to Baochai, not a concealed substitution, but "我知道，是宝姐姐。既议定了，我依长辈的意思。" (87, line 203) reads as acquiescence to an already decided arrangement, not the clearest affirmative choice. "别说娶个人便能治病，人家女孩儿不是药。" (87, line 197) is ethically legible but conspicuously programmatic. The prose asserts permission for a restrained family rite while mourning continues; I did not verify historical law or medical facts. All concerns are reading notes, not automatic rejection. The packet supplies no separate sample objects, so sample_checks is empty rather than invented.

Scope: MODEL literary opinion after actually reading the complete chapters 85-87, not archival qualification, historical-rule verification, provider verification or independent-human admission. This is a favorable but qualified reading, not an unread or pending review. Strength: the long illness retains a person with preferences and difficult humor; ch85 L55 '半年倒容易说，我今儿这半日还没过完呢。' gives the sick woman's own scale of time. Fluctuation is shown against attrition: ch85 L25 '天将亮时黛玉睡去，睡着脸色仍比前日好看，紫鹃在纸上却写不出一个“好”字，只记了吃的、醒的与坐的时刻。' The bedside contraction, tomorrow's thin cup and final cold medicine make the death moving without a retrospective last testament. Ch86 L155 '药还没吃么？再温一温。' is a helpless continuation of care, not a cure. Baochai's errors, servants' hunger and the shared meal resist a magical competent-wife solution; ch87 L251 '宝钗吃得慢，宝玉比往日多用几口，却没有谁拿这个数来报喜。' is especially good. Issues: the marriage assent '我知道，是宝姐姐。既议定了，我依长辈的意思。' at ch87 L203 is resignation rather than the more explored willing-but-frightened answer in read-cc6a6dfce4df89e5d3f76985. Repeated bowl, cloth and procedure passages can read as care-work demonstration; ch87 L197 '别说娶个人便能治病，人家女孩儿不是药。' states an ethically attractive thesis very cleanly. The final private scene is briefly crowded by Ying'er at L261. The poem stays uncompleted and unexpounded, but ch86 L111 says a previously tried character was half crossed out, so its revision surface is less plain than the untouched blank in the other sequences, not a proved closure error. Relative preference: tie with read-b364bc8365255d0e64c2e60a on the slow-illness/death arc; below that token on differentiated everyday voice and below read-cc6a6dfce4df89e5d3f76985 on marriage decision and patient agency. No total score or overall winner is asserted.

PASS is a local research-reading opinion only. Read the complete 85-87 sequence, lines 1-318 (156 prose paragraphs), in five nonoverlapping sequential blocks. "如此又过了两个月。" (86, line 113) explicitly lengthens the illness beyond chapter 85; further months and the distinction between expired initial restrictions and continuing mourning make chapter 87 legible without implying historical verification. Baoyu is away with his father at the ritual venue; the missed carriage route supplies a real communication obstacle, although the repeated pursuit is visibly serving the late-arrival plot. Two doctors see Daiyu before the death, and "医者重又察看，停了片刻，才轻轻摇头。" (86, line 171) keeps confirmation separate from servants guessing. Incomplete swallowing, the unaltered poem, repaired soft collar and residual habits make the death persuasive. However, "屋里没有谁说一段等着旁人记住的话。" (86, line 169) explains the intended anti-testament aesthetic instead of entirely trusting the scene. This token most clearly stages Baoyu being asked, taking time and then saying "我愿意照所议的办，只求不要急在眼下。" (87, line 237). Baochai has understood the situation and is not merely a restorative appliance; reciprocal physical closeness, furniture negotiations and the meal show an actual couple, without proving consummation. Several permission/expense/worker-duty explanations and explicit protections of names, papers and boundaries feel constraint-conscious. A strong research-readable sequence with pacing and narrative-explication reservations, not a complete human qualification, source claim, numerical score or overall winner. No packet-bound sample objects: sample_checks is empty.

Scope: MODEL literary opinion after actually reading the complete chapters 85-87; UNVERIFIED means no archival/historical/provider/human certification, not missing textual consumption. Strength: ch85 L23 '我也成了要她支应的人了。' makes Baoyu's new exclusion emotional rather than merely a visitation rule. Ch85 L61 '你不用这样替它掩饰，衣裳也不曾犯错。' lets Daiyu recognize wasting through the dress without a narrator explaining her dignity. The illness is explicitly extended by two months in ch86 and the changing household uses of water at L181 give grief physical continuity. Physicians arrive before death; the unattended recovery fantasy survives in Baoyu's '药还没吃么？再温一温。' at L187. The poem remains an ordinary unfinished composition, not a revealed final declaration. Marriage is this sequence's relative strength: ch87 L229 '我没有说她不好。只是有些事，我怕自己做得不周全。' and L237 '我愿意照所议的办，只求不要急在眼下。' allow deliberation rather than mere knowledge of the bride. Baochai's L241 '只是他请缓些，就缓些，不要催了他又说是我等不及。' has pride as well as compliance. The meal's tough bamboo-shoot fiber and L305 '回来就好，饭也没凉。' keep affection ordinary without explaining away the visit to the dead woman's door. Issues: the outward pursuit of Baoyu's departed carriage at ch86 L157 is somewhat overmanaged stage business, though internally plausible; longer summaries in early ch86 lessen the immediate bedside continuity. Ch86 L169 '屋里没有谁说一段等着旁人记住的话。' explicitly announces what the scene refuses. Repeated marriage-name confirmations and a very explanatory mourning-permission paragraph show the underlying instructional pressure. The postmarital compatibility is kinder and smoother than read-b364bc8365255d0e64c2e60a's food and book-bag disagreement. Relative preference: first on mourning-to-marriage negotiation, not first on every dimension; tie with read-cda9dc2b519ce26a634cb60a and read-b364bc8365255d0e64c2e60a for the open-poem treatment. No total score, automatic winner or human verdict.

PASS applies only to this model literary-research reading. Read every paragraph of chapters 85-87, lines 1-256 (125 prose paragraphs). The 85-to-86 dawn transition is direct, the illness already spans repeated ten-day intervals and seasonal clothing changes, and 87 explicitly waits further months; calendar resolution is looser than the tokens with a seven-month anchor or an extra stated two months. Daiyu sounds notably resistant to being reduced to care procedures: "正是要没用处的，有用处的你们背着我说够了。" (85, line 49). Her wit, clothing choices and unfinished ordinary poem give the quiet death individuality. Baoyu actually visits on the last morning and returns during the doctor visit; his later departure to arrange the doctor transport gives lateness a care-driven irony, but also makes the precisely timed absence feel more author-arranged than unavoidable. "一阵极细的呼吸过去，隔了很久，没有接来。" (86, line 145) earns restraint without a declamatory death speech. Medication identity is unusually auditable: "盖布还是煎新药时那一块，剩药仍有大半碗。" (86, line 151); this is internally clear but the adjacent dose, payment and container assurances can sound like custody documentation. Marriage notification is explicit: "我今儿叫你来，是先与你说清楚，不是等到那一天才说。" (87, line 185). Yet Baoyu mainly asks about rooms/books and never gives as clear an affirmative marital assent as in the strongest comparison; informed awareness is not the same thing as a fully dramatized choice. Family-rite permission is stated, not historically checked. The wedding-day walk, meal and final bedside proximity are coherent, with no forced cure for grief. These are substantive reservations, not fatal contradictions or automatic rejection; no human-admission/authenticity judgement and no fabricated sample checks.

Scope: fully consumed chapters 85-87, MODEL literary comparison only; no archival, provider, historical or human pass. Strength: the household is not frictionless. Baochai's ch85 L47 '我只说晚一刻，倒没有问她这一刻在哪里。' acknowledges that fixing a meal timetable has consequences for someone else's work. Daiyu's L49 '正是要没用处的，有用处的你们背着我说够了。' directly contests reduction to a care project. The quiet '我还在这里坐坐，好不好？' / '你若坐得住，就坐。' at ch85 L75 feels intimate without replacing personality with eloquence. The poem remains genuinely open; after the failed handling of paper and wrist, ch86 L125 lets her notice an insect instead, so not every glance is turned into a literary omen. The fine blue line of the medicine bowl binds the same evening dose to Baoyu's late arrival. Ch86 L165 '紫鹃坐在原来的地方，没有拿起居纸添晨起的字。' earns a stopping point out of the previous chapter's repeated recording. Issues: arrival is causally legible but less convincing as drama because Baoyu has already visited twice, heard the severe prognosis, then personally leaves to arrange the physician's transport at ch86 L135; a reader can wonder why he does not delegate that errand. That is a conditional motivation concern, not a claimed contradiction. The explicit bowl identification and multiple permission/housekeeping summaries sometimes sound like proof of continuity. The ch87 L193 two-item permission slip gives the mourning-to-marriage transition a particularly administrative feel. Baoyu is informed and accommodated, but his specific wish to marry is less developed than in read-cc6a6dfce4df89e5d3f76985. The wedding-day meal, collar touch, bedside negotiation and shared quiet are convincing, although the long mutual arrangement tail risks overextension. Relative preference: second to read-b364bc8365255d0e64c2e60a in voice and least-engineered lived life; tie with that token on cold-medicine embodiment, but below the other three on late-arrival motivation. Neither inferred procedural fidelity nor lack of textual inconsistency determines literary preference. No overall winner or total score.

PASS is limited to coherent literary research reading by this model. Read the full sequence through its final paragraph, lines 1-308 (151 prose paragraphs). The May rain and two subsequent monthly medicine lists connect well to "元春身后的丧务，自初时忙乱至今，已过了七个月。" (86, line 103); 87 adds further months and extends beyond the first married day. This is a clear internal calendar, not a verified historical mourning timetable. The ledger has human limits: "我这里只怕记漏，不是要一声声数。姑娘嫌烦呢。" (85, line 41). Daiyu retains minute interests almost to silence; "新粥明儿再吃，今儿先放一放。" (86, line 149) gives tomorrow its ordinary weight. The afternoon doctor and later recall avoid a single diagnostic miracle, though the messenger bounce through Baoyu's changing whereabouts visibly engineers his lateness. Marriage assent is conventional and explicit: "儿子知道，凭老太太和太太作主。" (87, line 231), less deliberative than a token that lets him request time. Continuing mourning and specifically permitted family rites are distinguished in the text. This token gives the new couple unusually useful differences: "你既爱这个，不必都说和我一样。" (87, line 295), unlike tastes in rice/tea, a book-bag repair disagreement and different quilt preferences. Baochai is less flattened into frictionless competence. Reservations: it still repeatedly explains who knew what, why supplies were adequate and which expense was legitimate; the late-arrival/cold-medicine/paper/wedding/needlework architecture is conspicuously shared by the four readings. Some construction remains visible, but no hard sequence-breaking contradiction compelled rejection. No original-authenticity or complete-human-pass claim; no separate samples in packet, so sample_checks is empty.

Scope: MODEL opinion from reading all of chapters 85-87, not an archival/pass authority, provider verification or independent-human review. Strength: this is my relative preference for differentiated everyday voices and unengineered domestic texture. Daiyu at ch85 L89 '我今日爱这个，明日未必。你别把一口话做成一年规矩。' refuses being stabilized as a rule, and the small involuntary tears at L91 bring her emotional life into the bodily illness rather than leaving death wholly dry and clinical. Ch85 L41 '二爷，我这里只怕记漏，不是要一声声数。姑娘嫌烦呢。' also limits surveillance. Ch86 L177 '紫鹃拿起那块平日铺在膝上托碗的细布，折了一下，才发现今日无处再铺。' makes bereavement a failed habitual action. The evening dose is actually followed through its shallow water basin to the cool bowl, so Baoyu's L187 '药还没吃么？再温一温。' has material, not merely symbolic, force. The poem's blank is not filled, recited as a testament or solved by another person. Mourning, a legitimate quiet wedding, bed-sharing and grief outside the old door coexist. Newly married Baochai is not simply self-effacing: ch87 L295 '你既爱这个，不必都说和我一样。' separates her tastes from Baoyu's wish to oblige, and the book-bag repair remains unfinished after they dispute which thickness he supplied. Issues: seven months of illness is explicitly summarized in ch86 L103, but final-day information and Baoyu's detour for an old book are withheld-and-relayed at some length; the L163 detour can feel arranged to secure lateness. Mother/aunt dialogue about a wife not being a food persuader states the domestic ethic unusually clearly. The bride and groom acquiesce to elders rather than undertake the more searching negotiation of read-cc6a6dfce4df89e5d3f76985, and the final household vignettes run across additional days, reducing concentrated wedding-day closure. Relative preference: first in everyday voice and felt life, tied with read-6aa712b0359c98f49720d3a3 for the slow decline/death and with read-cda9dc2b519ce26a634cb60a for the medicine motif; below read-cc6a6dfce4df89e5d3f76985 on marriage agency. No total score or automatic whole-sequence winner.
